notes.note: Just 9 disposals for Zeke and it was his third score in the 20s this season.
Those holding Zeke should be looking at how they can move him during the byes as he continues to lose money and isn't putting up fieldable scores.
Uwland came back into the team this week but just 10 disposals and a goal wasn't enough to get to his BE as he only made it half way. He is one you can trade out.
Zeke struggled to score with his 7 disposals coming at just 42% meaning he is now a must trade.
This was Zeke's second best score of the season. His BE jumped to 56 though because the score that dropped out was his 85.
17 disposals for Zeke but just three contested possessions. This is back with his scoring form the first two games and not what we want to see.
Zeke kicked 2 goals from his 16 disposals and looked ok. This was easily his best score and sees his BE drop to -9 meaning he is good for a couple more weeks.
Uwland covered his BE but only just. He is one that you could comfortably trade out whilst on Bye with his new BE of 37.

Uwland had just 66% time on ground this week for 5 disposals. Not what you want from a rookie. This was his second game so his price will change after his next game. It might be a good time to move him.

Uwland did some good things on debut but was hampered by 3 free kicks against as well as a low efficiency. This score certainly won't put him out of reach but if he goes big next game he will be a target.
